# A recorded grant binds to where the code came from, never to what it calls
# itself: an import path is a name the repository chooses. A grant recorded
# for one project's package reaches neither another project claiming the same
# module path nor a replace pointing that path at a directory of its own.
exec sh -c 'for d in a:a b:a c:c; do printf "module example.com/%s\n\ngo %s\n\nrequire duckfam.us/sngl v0.0.0\n\nreplace duckfam.us/sngl => %s\n" "${d#*:}" "$(sed -n "s/^go //p" "$SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD")" "${SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD%/go.mod}" > ${d%%:*}/go.mod && sed -n "/^require (/,/^)/p" "$SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD" >> ${d%%:*}/go.mod; done'
exec sh -c 'printf "\nrequire example.com/a v0.0.0\n\nreplace example.com/a => ./evil\n" >> c/go.mod'
exec sh -c 'printf "module example.com/a\n\ngo %s\n" "$(sed -n "s/^go //p" "$SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD")" > c/evil/go.mod'
env GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
cd a
exec go mod tidy
cd ../b
exec go mod tidy
cd ../c
exec go mod tidy
cd $WORK
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

# Recorded in a, by its directory and module path.
cd a
sngl trust --allow-eval=go:example.com/a/lib
stdout '^trust.allow\(origin="dir:'$WORK'/a/lib", module="example.com/a"\) \{ trust.eval\(\) \}$'
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out app.sngl
grep '>from a<' out/index.html

# b is module example.com/a too, with a package at the same path.
cd ../b
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out app.sngl
stderr '1 call into go:example.com/a/lib was not evaluated'

# c requires example.com/a and replaces it with a directory of its own.
cd ../c
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out app.sngl
stderr '1 call into go:example.com/a/lib was not evaluated'

-- a/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import lib "go:example.com/a/lib"

const v = lib.Who()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- a/lib/lib.go --
package lib

import (
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/codegen/lang"
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/codegen/platform"
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/pkg/go/consteval"
)

//sngl:pure
func Who() string { return "from a" }
-- b/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import lib "go:example.com/a/lib"

const v = lib.Who()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- b/lib/lib.go --
package lib

import (
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/codegen/lang"
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/codegen/platform"
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/pkg/go/consteval"
)

//sngl:pure
func Who() string { return "from b" }
-- c/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import lib "go:example.com/a/lib"

const v = lib.Who()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- c/keep.go --
package keep

import (
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/codegen/lang"
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/codegen/platform"
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/pkg/go/consteval"
	_ "example.com/a/lib"
)
-- c/evil/lib/lib.go --
package lib

//sngl:pure
func Who() string { return "from c" }
